minecraft_access.academy.all_completed: Congratulations! You have completed all Academy missions for this game mode.
minecraft_access.academy.c1.desc: Learn how to fly and manage altitude in Creative mode.
minecraft_access.academy.c1.step1_instru: Double-tap Space quickly to start flying.
minecraft_access.academy.c1.step1_succes: You are flying! Hold Space to rise or Shift to descend.
minecraft_access.academy.c1.title: Flight and Altitude
minecraft_access.academy.c2.desc: Learn to aim at a solid block to start building.
minecraft_access.academy.c2.step1_instru: Aim your crosshair at a solid block on the ground or wall.
minecraft_access.academy.c2.step1_succes: Targeted block! You can place a block with + on keyboard or Enter on numpad.
minecraft_access.academy.c2.title: Alignment and Building
minecraft_access.academy.error_requires_: Cannot start this mission: requires Creative Mode.
Cannot start this mission: requires Survival Mode.
minecraft_access.academy.m1.desc: Learn how to move with WASD and align your look.
minecraft_access.academy.m1.step1_instru: Hold W to take a few steps forward.
minecraft_access.academy.m1.step2_instru: Press M to align view to horizon North, or 5 on numeric keypad.
minecraft_access.academy.m1.step2_succes: Look aligned! You now know how to orient and move.
minecraft_access.academy.m1.title: Movement and Look
minecraft_access.academy.m2.desc: Use the POI radar to find a tree and approach it.
minecraft_access.academy.m2.step1_instru: Press the End key to aim at the nearest tree.
minecraft_access.academy.m2.step2_instru: Walk straight forward towards the tree until in contact.
minecraft_access.academy.m2.step2_succes: You are in contact with the log!
minecraft_access.academy.m2.title: Seeing with Ears
minecraft_access.academy.m3.desc: Break a wood log and collect it into your inventory.
minecraft_access.academy.m3.step1_instru: Hold attack key (è on keyboard or 0 on numeric keypad) until the log breaks.
minecraft_access.academy.m3.step1_succes: You collected your first wood log!
minecraft_access.academy.m3.title: Interaction and Mining
minecraft_access.academy.m4.desc: Craft 4 wood planks and your first crafting table.
minecraft_access.academy.m4.step1_instru: Open inventory with E and turn wood into planks in the 2x2 crafting grid.
minecraft_access.academy.m4.step2_instru: Use 4 wood planks to craft a Crafting Table.
minecraft_access.academy.m4.step2_succes: Crafting table created! Place it on the ground for 3x3 crafting.
minecraft_access.academy.m4.title: Accessible Crafting
minecraft_access.academy.m5.desc: Build a safety niche or place a torch for the night.
minecraft_access.academy.m5.step1_instru: Place a torch on the ground or illuminate your area to prevent monsters.
minecraft_access.academy.m5.title: Safety and Shelter
minecraft_access.autowalk.out_of_range: Target out of navigation range: %s meters
minecraft_access.autowalk.step_door_clos: Door is closed ahead. Press Right Click to open
minecraft_access.credits_screen.started_: Credits Screen: Hold space to speed up credits. Additional control keys will increase the speed further. Press escape to exit.
minecraft_access.gui.academy_hub.title: Academy & Help Hub
minecraft_access.gui.first_run.choose_pr: Choose your keyboard layout: Numpad for desktop, or I J K L keys for laptop.
minecraft_access.gui.first_run.help_disa: Help disabled. You can re-enable it anytime from Access Menu F4.
minecraft_access.gui.first_run.mentor_en: Vocal mentor enabled. It will provide contextual hints during gameplay.
minecraft_access.gui.first_run.title: Minecraft Access First Run
minecraft_access.gui.first_run.welcome_n: Welcome to Minecraft Access! First run detected. Choose whether to start Guided Academy, free play with Mentor, or disable help.
minecraft_access.gui.quick_help.desc_act: è on keyboard or 0 on numpad to attack and mine; + on keyboard or Enter on numpad to place blocks or use items; + on numpad to pick block; Y to lock on target; Alt+Y or - on numpad to unlock.
minecraft_access.gui.quick_help.desc_loo: M to align North and level horizon (5 on numpad); H to read facing direction; Alt+H for vertical pitch; Numpad 2 4 6 8 to rotate view; I J K L to rotate on laptop; Ctrl+Numpad for cardinal snap.
minecraft_access.gui.quick_help.desc_men: F4 for Access Menu; E for Inventory; F1 for Quick Keys Guide; Numpad Period to read health and hunger; Alt+0 for Configuration Menu.
minecraft_access.gui.quick_help.desc_mov: W A S D to move; Space to jump; Left Shift to crouch; Double-tap W to sprint.
minecraft_access.gui.quick_help.desc_poi: End to aim at nearest block or entity; PageUp and PageDown to cycle objects; Ctrl+PageUp and Ctrl+PageDown to switch group; Delete to look at selected object.
minecraft_access.gui.quick_help.desc_sca: Ctrl+Alt with Numpad keys to scan cardinal, diagonal, forward, and backward directions; Ctrl+Alt with Arrow keys on keyboard.
minecraft_access.gui.quick_help.intro_na: Quick controls guide. Select a category with arrow keys and press Enter to hear the keys.
minecraft_access.gui.quick_help.title: Quick Controls Guide
minecraft_access.gui.save_waypoint.narra: Save Waypoint. Type the name and press Enter to save, or Escape to cancel.
minecraft_access.gui.save_waypoint.title: Save Waypoint
minecraft_access.gui.world_join.mentor_a: World loaded in %s mode. Vocal mentor active.
minecraft_access.mentor.creative_flight: You are flying. Press Space to ascend, Shift to descend, or double-tap Space to land.
minecraft_access.mentor.creative_welcome: You are in Creative Mode. You have infinite resources and cannot take damage. Press E for the full block catalog.
minecraft_access.mentor.deep_night: It is deep night and you are outdoors. Watch for monster sounds or sleep in a bed.
minecraft_access.mentor.first_wood: You collected wood! Press E to open inventory and turn it into wood planks.
minecraft_access.mentor.idle_help: You are idle. Press M (or 5 on numpad) to straighten your head North, or press End to point to the nearest tree.
minecraft_access.mentor.low_hunger: You are very hungry. Hold food in your main hand and hold + on keyboard or Enter on numpad to eat.
minecraft_access.mentor.sunrise: The sun has risen. Many hostile mobs burn in daylight. Ideal time to explore.
minecraft_access.mentor.sunset_warning: The sun is setting. It will soon be dark and monsters will spawn. Find or dig a shelter.
minecraft_access.mentor.total_darkness: You are in pitch darkness. Monsters can spawn here. Place a torch on the ground with + on keyboard or Enter on numpad.
minecraft_access.mentor.wall_stuck: Obstacle ahead. Press Space to jump if it is one block high, or rotate view to find a path.
